ask: We keep the CLI, but we turn claim extraction & check creation into skills so coding agents can pick these up. These should work cross-harness, keep state in sqlite, and also enforce the same pydantic schema. I still would like automatic extraction to work, and decision models to be optional add-ons that claude can call. Claude / skills should primarily call CLI arguments, and claims extraction and checks should be delegated to a specialized subagent (the main process doesn't care about the intermediary results, only the summarized results). This should be part of kmctl proper, and should go through the loop.
